entities.name: RNF8
observations: The 629-aa query sequence is homologous to curated vertebrate RNF8 proteins, with 54.9–57.1% identity and approximately 75–77% query coverage.
The sequence contains an FHA domain at residues 176–247 and a C3HC4/RING-type zinc-finger domain at approximately residues 543–582.
RNF8 is an E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase involved in DNA-damage signaling and repair-dependent chromatin remodeling.
Curated homolog annotations place RNF8 in the nucleus and cytoplasm, at DNA double-strand breaks, telomeres, and the cytokinetic midbody.
RNF8 forms a homodimer and associates with E2 enzymes including UBE2N/UBC13 and UBE2V2.

entities.name: DNA damage response
observations: RNF8-dependent ubiquitination of chromatin proteins helps recruit DNA-repair factors to DNA double-strand breaks.

entities.name: Protein ubiquitination
observations: RNF8 functions as an E3 ubiquitin ligase and can promote distinct ubiquitin-chain outcomes through different E2 partnerships.
